config.title: RSGL
config.desc.outDir: Output directory for generated resource pack files. Empty uses the nearest pack.mcmeta directory.
config.desc.minecraftVersion: Minecraft version used for RSGL validation and generation.
config.desc.defaultAssetsPath: Fallback vanilla assets path used when validating generated references. Empty falls back to McResHelper.defaultMcAssetsPath when available.
config.desc.resourcePackLoadOrder: Additional resource pack roots used when validating generated references. Empty falls back to McResHelper.resourcePackLoadOrder when available.
config.desc.emitSourceMap: Emit RSGL source maps next to generated files.
